nodes.title: Babai's theorem: graph isomorphism in quasipolynomial time

nodes.summary: The proposition that graph isomorphism is decidable in quasipolynomial time: there are a function $D$ from pairs of graph codes to Booleans, an exponent $c \in \mathbb{N}$, and a deterministic multi-stack Turing machine with a time function $t : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ that, on the bit encoding of every pair $(G, H)$, outputs the single bit $D(G, H)$ within $t(\ell)$ steps, where $\ell$ is the length of the…
nodes.title: The quasipolynomial graph isomorphism statement

nodes.summary: The bit encoding of a pair $(G, H)$ of graph codes is the bit encoding of $G$ followed by the bit encoding of $H$.
nodes.title: Bit encoding of a pair of graph codes

nodes.summary: The bit encoding of a graph code with $n$ vertices and adjacency matrix $A$ is the prefix-free encoding of $n$ followed by the $n^2$ entries of $A$, as bits, in row-major order: $A_{0,0}, A_{0,1}, \dots, A_{0,n-1}, A_{1,0}, \dots, A_{n-1,n-1}$.
nodes.title: Bit encoding of a graph code

nodes.summary: A graph code consists of a vertex count $n \in \mathbb{N}$, with vertices $0, \dots, n-1$, and a Boolean adjacency matrix $A$ on these vertices that is symmetric ($A_{ij} = A_{ji}$ for all $i, j$) and loop-free ($A_{ii}$ is false for every $i$).
nodes.title: Graph codes

nodes.summary: Graph codes $G$ and $H$ with adjacency matrices $A$ and $B$ are isomorphic when they have the same vertex count $n$ and there is a permutation $\sigma$ of the vertices $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$ such that $A_{ij} = B_{\sigma(i)\sigma(j)}$ for all $i, j$.
nodes.title: Isomorphism of graph codes

nodes.summary: The binary digits of $n \in \mathbb{N}$, most significant first, as a list of bits with the digit $1$ read as true and $0$ as false; for $n = 0$ this is the single digit $0$.
nodes.title: Binary digits of a natural number

nodes.summary: The prefix-free encoding of $n \in \mathbb{N}$ consists of $k$ true bits, where $k$ is the number of binary digits of $n$, then one false bit, then the binary digits of $n$, most significant first.
nodes.title: Prefix-free encoding of a natural number

nodes.summary: For an exponent $c \in \mathbb{N}$ and an input length $n \in \mathbb{N}$, the quasipolynomial time bound is $q_c(n) = 2^{(\lfloor \log_2(n+2) \rfloor + 2)^c}$.
nodes.title: Quasipolynomial time bound

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
